scope: Prospective screening and qualification rules for the fixed PULSE and R prototypes; written before either has quality results. Observed210 is development, sealed9/10/12 is consumed only after one actual-source candidate is chosen and frozen.

development.materials: Same210 observed clips and fixed36PCM controls; retain all normal rejects, errors, negative cases and all four modes.

R.gateRationale: R changes chart selection only. It must improve actual note heads, while all audio analysis and clock outputs remain exact rather than claiming a clock gain.

development.selection: Among candidates meeting their fixed development rules, choose greatest macro head70 gain; ties within1e-9 prefer R for lower added runtime work. Do not combine or tune candidates after scores without a new declared development experiment.

freshQualification.statisticalBoundary: Conditional on the fixed ten genres; no artist/work independence or population claim.
